Body.Content:
What and why

Microsoft is retiring SharePoint Server access through the standalone SharePoint mobile apps for iOS and Android. After this change, these apps will support SharePoint Online only.

Rollout schedule

  • Retirement (Worldwide, GCC, GCC High, DoD): Beginning November 27, 2026

Impact on your organization

Who is affected

  • Organizations with users who access SharePoint Server through the SharePoint mobile apps for iOS or Android

Platforms and services

  • SharePoint mobile apps for iOS and Android
  • SharePoint Server

What will happen

  • Users will no longer be able to access SharePoint Server through the standalone SharePoint mobile apps for iOS or Android.
  • The SharePoint mobile apps will support SharePoint Online only.

Action required and recommendations

Before this change takes effect:

  • Notify users who access SharePoint Server through the SharePoint mobile apps that this access is being retired.
  • Update your internal documentation and support materials as appropriate.

Learn more

  • About SharePoint mobile app | Microsoft Support
  • SharePoint mobile app for Android | Microsoft Support

Compliance considerations

No compliance considerations identified. Review as appropriate for your organization.
